top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 83, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
GFNY Uppsala's rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 83 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GFNY Uppsala's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
GFNY Uppsala's rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
When someone attacks on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At GFNY Uppsala, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 83 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GFNY Uppsala. Train it until it feels boring.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
The aerobic base that lets you ride rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling at tempo for 83 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
At GFNY Uppsala, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what GFNY Uppsala's rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling actually does to you.

race_overlay.heat: August in Uppsala, Sweden (start/finish at Ulva Kvarn) can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before GFNY Uppsala and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GFNY Uppsala’s 83 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at GFNY Uppsala requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 83 miles of rolling countryside, flat-to-gently-rolling in Uppsala, Sweden (start/finish at Ulva Kvarn).
